I wrote the O3 lesson, a quiz with its key, and a cheat sheet. I haven't opened the lesson in a browser. I tried a word count, but the command wasn't approved, so I haven't checked the length against 30 minutes.

**Lesson:** `lessons/0001-context-and-memory.html` (30 minutes, objective O3). It follows your `PREFERENCES.md`: each section has learning goals, the idea, a worked example, a misconception box and a check-yourself question with the answer hidden. There are no analogies.

The sections are:
- **Context window:** what the model sees at one call, and why the program re-sends it every step.
- **Between steps:** how context grows, context rot, and clearing old tool results or compacting.
- **Between sessions:** what survives a session and how notes work as memory.
- **Retrieval:** how the assistant finds the right passage in a long manual.
- **Cost worked example:** two assistant designs compared on token cost, with a faded "your turn".

The token counts in the examples are illustrative, not measured. The split between a program-owned record for exact facts like training status and model-written notes for soft details is my design advice, not something from a source.

**Sources:** the main one is Anthropic's [Effective context engineering for AI agents](https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/effective-context-engineering-for-ai-agents). The others are the [Claude memory tool docs](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/memory-tool.md) and the [Lost in the Middle paper](https://Huggingface.co/papers/2307.03172). I added all three to `RESOURCES.md`. I found no good source on chunking and embedding choices, so I listed that as a gap.

**Other files:**
- **Quiz 0002:** `quizzes/0002.json` has six items, mostly free response, with one six-option multiple choice. The key is `keys/0002.json`. It is ready when you want it.
- **Cheat sheet:** `cheatsheets/context-and-memory.html` has the terms and rules to look up later.
- **`NOTES.md`:** I recorded the lesson and quiz, plus three misconceptions to watch for.
- **Quiz 0001:** it is still ungraded, so I didn't write a learning record.
